transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I have an intense, overwhelming fear of dogs that is really starting to affect my daily life. It's gotten to the point where I feel like I can't manage it on my own anymore.
When you see a dog or even think you might encounter one, do you feel immediate intense fear or panic? Do you go out of your way to avoid places where dogs might be?

Yes, absolutely. Just the thought of running into a dog makes me incredibly anxious, and if I actually see one, I panic instantly. I also actively avoid parks, certain streets, and entire neighborhoods just to make sure I don't cross paths with one.
How long have you had this fear of dogs, and has it been present for at least 6 months?
Yes, my fear of dogs is extremely severe and it has been going on for about 7 months now. So it has definitely been present for more than 6 months.
How much is this fear interfering with your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or errands?

It interferes with my life constantly. I’ve had to turn down social plans with friends who have pets, and I even changed my commute to work to avoid streets where people walk their dogs. It has severely restricted my daily routine and made simple errands incredibly stressful.
